story: US-008 (attestation independence) and US-009 (dependency on US-008)
authorized_at_provenance: Captured from `date -u` immediately before writing; the owner answered the two-question AskUserQuestion immediately prior (standing no-estimates rule).
authorization_basis: US-008 reality review (session 01a04179-d37e-78f0-b6fe-995572b3709f) classified the story's remaining blockers: AC2/AC3/AC4 CLOSED; AC1 open on tool identities (OWNER_ACT_PENDING at acquisition) + booted-host facts (MEASUREMENT_TIME) + executable digests (IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENT); AC5 open on future Java/Rust source/executable/adapter digests and the independently rebuilt analyzer (IMPLEMENTATION_DEPENDENT); story-note 'independently attested plan commit' open (OWNER_ACT_PENDING, impossible solo). The classification exposed a dependency circularity: US-009 dependsOn US-008, but US-008's remaining artifacts depend on US-009+ outputs.

us009_dependency.from: US-009 dependsOn includes US-008 with passes=true semantics.
us009_dependency.to: US-009's US-008 prerequisite is satisfied by the FROZEN AND OWNER-ATTESTED PREREGISTRATION (its true purpose: the plan, workloads, sampling rules, statistics, and thresholds must be immutable BEFORE any Rust source or tuning exists, so measurements cannot be gamed). That precondition is met: plan digest 5fb3fea8b5f1213b7ae5039ce7574c23bf720f543b0bd8c568abe596eef86993 frozen at 51257ac, OWNER_ATTESTED, thresholds locked, forbidden-decisions list frozen, and the attestation PREDATES all Rust implementation. US-008 itself stays honestly passes=false until its measurement-time and implementation-dependent artifacts exist.
unchanged_invariants: No benchmark sample, tuning, or performance claim before measurement artifacts bind
The frozen plan cannot be altered after Rust work begins (digest-bound; any change voids the attestation)
benchplanctl keeps failing closed until full binding

us008_attestation_independence.from: Story note requires an 'independently attested plan commit'.
us008_attestation_independence.to: OWNER-ONLY ATTESTATION ACCEPTED for the plan-freeze criterion, recorded as a labeled deviation: attestation_state OWNER_ATTESTED with assurance OWNER_ATTESTED_NOT_INDEPENDENT and independent_review_claimed:false. The INDEPENDENTLY_ATTESTED state, its structural guards, and its disclosed limits remain in the code unchanged — if an independent attestor ever exists, the stronger state remains reachable and preferable. No independent review is claimed anywhere.
unchanged_invariants: Assurance labels never overstate: OWNER_ATTESTED_NOT_INDEPENDENT everywhere
The structural unreachability of INDEPENDENTLY_ATTESTED by relabeling stays enforced
US-027's independent-acceptance question is NOT prejudged by this amendment
